allowed_fields: FY2024 and FY2023-comparable revenue and segment profit excluding investment income for professional logistics, forwarding and related business, and e-commerce
FY2024 and FY2023-comparable adjusted parent profit
FY2024 and FY2023-comparable major business volumes disclosed in the same annual report
sales expense, administrative expense, expensed R&D, and revenue
logistics-industry fiscal subsidies and other recurring government subsidies, including any disclosed segment or route attribution
reported segment-definition, subsidy-definition, consolidation-perimeter, or accounting changes
first_match: LOCAL_UNKNOWN only if comparable three-segment profit or adjusted parent profit itself is unavailable
MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH if segment, period, perimeter, or accounting definitions cannot be bridged
ADVERSE_STRUCTURAL_CORE_EROSION if three-segment profit <= CNY 3.0bn and adjusted parent profit < CNY 2.8bn with an observed customer-loss, price-cut, structural-cost, or credit-loss carrier

FAVORABLE_SELF_FUNDED_IMPROVEMENT if three-segment profit >= CNY 3.7bn, adjusted parent profit >= CNY 3.4bn, at least two major volume axes do not decline, and matched subsidy intensity plus persistent expense burden do not rise while subsidy-before profit improves

MIXED_REPORTED_RESILIENCE_ATTRIBUTION_UNPROVEN if three-segment profit is CNY 3.2bn to CNY 3.7bn and adjusted parent profit >= CNY 2.8bn but subsidy cannot be matched to the same boundary or subsidy-before profit is unavailable
MIXED_COMPLETE_RESIDUAL for the remaining complete comparable cases

allowed_fields: FY2024 and FY2023-comparable Sinotrans-DHL revenue and net profit
group equity-method investment income and its material investee composition
actual dividends received from Sinotrans-DHL or other material joint ventures if disclosed
Sinotrans-DHL margin, demand, share, pricing, persistent-cost, impairment, or major-customer facts if disclosed
holding percentage, control, accounting-policy, or perimeter changes
first_match: LOCAL_UNKNOWN if Sinotrans-DHL comparable net profit or group equity-method income is unavailable
MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH if holding, control, accounting, period, or perimeter cannot be bridged
ADVERSE_JV_ECONOMIC_DECLINE if Sinotrans-DHL net profit <= CNY 2.8bn and group equity-method income <= CNY 1.8bn with an observed demand, share, pricing, cost, impairment, or customer-loss carrier
FAVORABLE_JV_DURABILITY if Sinotrans-DHL net profit >= CNY 3.7bn and group equity-method income >= CNY 2.35bn without nonrecurring support
NEUTRAL_JV_RANGE if Sinotrans-DHL net profit is CNY 3.15bn to CNY 3.7bn and group equity-method income is CNY 2.04bn to CNY 2.5bn without a structural adverse carrier
MIXED_COMPLETE_RESIDUAL for the remaining complete comparable cases

allowed_fields: consolidated operating cash flow
cash paid to acquire fixed assets, intangible assets, and other long-term assets
reported segment capital expenditure using the same definition as FY2023
maintenance versus expansion capex only where explicitly attributable
NCI cash claims or distributions and parent cash-access evidence
parent dividends received from subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates if disclosed
credit-loss charges and the economic carrier or persistence of receivable deterioration
cash and cash equivalents, interest-bearing debt, and the issuer-defined net-debt bridge
perimeter, cash-flow-classification, capex-definition, restricted-cash, acquisition, or disposal changes

formulas.cash_flow_statement_purchase_proxy: consolidated OCF minus cash paid to acquire fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets
formulas.segment_capex_proxy: consolidated OCF minus disclosed segment capital expenditure
formulas.comparison_rule: keep each proxy on its own definition across periods; never substitute or mix the two

first_match: MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH only for an unbridgeable group cash, period, perimeter, or capex-definition mismatch

SEVERE_STRUCTURAL_CASH_LOSS if either same-definition group proxy is negative for two comparable periods with persistent credit loss or maintenance cash consumption, material net-cash contraction, and an irreversible carrier lasting or expected to last at least 12 months; parent scope may remain unknown and owner cash then stays conditional

ADVERSE_CASH_ONLY if either same-definition group proxy is negative for two comparable periods with persistent credit loss or maintenance cash consumption and net-cash contraction but the severe irreversibility test is not met; parent scope may remain unknown and permanent-loss constraint still tightens

POSITIVE_GROUP_PROXY_OWNER_SCOPE_OPEN if same-definition group cash is positive with no persistent adverse carrier but NCI, parent access, or maintenance-versus-growth scope remains open; owner cash remains conditional

FAVORABLE_PARENT_CASH_CLOSED if scope is closed, FY2024 parent-distributable owner cash >= CNY 2.0bn, cumulative FY2022-FY2024 parent-distributable owner cash is positive, and no material transfer restriction exists
NEUTRAL_POSITIVE_GROUP_PROXY if scope is closed, group cash is positive, parent-distributable owner cash < CNY 2.0bn, and no persistent adverse carrier exists
MIXED_COMPLETE_RESIDUAL for the remaining complete comparable cases

output_requirements: Record raw reported values, units, responsibility boundary, printed page, and source locator before derived values.
Apply the listed first-match in order and identify the matched condition.
Keep reported profitability resilience separate from subsidy-before commercial attribution.
Keep each cash proxy on its own definition; parent-scope unknown may restrict owner cash but must not erase observed permanent-loss carriers.
Keep UNKNOWN and mismatch local and continue settling other cells.
Do not infer management quality, investment utility, valuation, enterprise conclusions, prices, returns, or investment action.
forbidden_inputs: preoutcome judgment narrative or treatment mapping beyond the explicit cell contract and frozen numeric references above
any source other than the one authorized official annual report
